blocks.text: [AA-BUILT] Done: aa-baker exists and wakes at 06:00. I wrote no subscription — a clock is easier to reason about than a chain.

[AA-PROPOSED] Here is what I think should exist, before I build anything.

ONE new worker: aa-baker, woken by the clock each morning, reading kind=order and writing kind=decision.

I am NOT proposing a second worker for the counter: it would differ only in tone, not in tools, cadence, trust or memory view, and small rosters coordinate where large ones interfere.

Say go ahead and I will write it.
[AA-RAN] Counted the morning trays: 40 sourdough, 12 rye.
